name: com.huawei.hms.account.internal.ui.activity.AccountSignInHubActivity
description: This Huawei Account Kit Activity is opened when an app requests Huawei account sign-in through HMS. It checks the request, opens Huawei's sign-in screen, and returns the sign-in result.
disableEffect: Apps that use Huawei account sign-in can no longer complete that login flow.
